Happy Vat Savitri 2026 Wishes: WhatsApp Messages, Sabitri Brata Images and HD Wallpapers to Share
Celebrate Vat Savitri Vrat 2026 with heartfelt wishes, WhatsApp messages, Sabitri Brata greetings, HD wallpapers and beautiful images to share with your loved ones on this auspicious occasion.
Team BTMay 16, 2026, 07:05 IST

Every year, Vat Savitri Vrat is a sacred Hindu fast observed mainly by married women for the long life and well-being of their husbands. It is especially popular in several states like Maharashtra, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat. Celebrated on the new moon day in month of Jyeshtha, this year Vat Savitri Vrat 2026 falls on Saturday, May 16. As Vat Savitri Vrat nears, we bring to you a collection of Happy Vat Savitri 2026 greetings, Vat Savitri Vrat SMS and beautiful Sabitri Brat greetings which you can share online and celebrate this auspicious occasion with family and friends.

While people celebrate this fasting day with great faith, exchanging Vat Savitri Vrat messages and HD images as WhatsApp status or Instagram post is also a popular way to celebrate the day. Take a look at these beautiful Vat Savitri Vrat wishes and messages that can bring positivity, marital bliss and happiness in your life. You can download these heartwarming wishes and messages and share with your friends and loved ones on this day. These images can also be used as WhatsApp status and Facebook status on Vat Savitri Vrat 2026.

Happy Vat Savitri 2026 Wishes

Wishing you a blessed Vat Savitri Vrat filled with happiness, peace and everlasting togetherness.

May Goddess Savitri bless your married life with love, strength and prosperity. Happy Vat Savitri Vrat 2026.

Sending heartfelt wishes for a joyful and peaceful Vat Savitri Vrat. May your family always stay blessed.

May this sacred fast strengthen the bond of love and bring positivity into your life. Happy Vat Savitri.

Wishing you good health, happiness and a lifetime of togetherness on the auspicious occasion of Vat Savitri Vrat.

May your prayers and devotion bring harmony, love and prosperity into your home. Happy Vat Savitri 2026.

On this holy occasion, may Goddess Savitri shower her blessings upon you and your family always.

May the spirit of Vat Savitri Vrat fill your life with faith, joy and endless blessings.

Warm wishes on Vat Savitri Vrat 2026. May your relationship always be filled with understanding and happiness.

Wishing you a beautiful Vat Savitri Vrat and a life full of love, peace and cherished moments with your loved ones.

The most important aspect of the vrat is the tithi timings. According to Drikpanchang, the Amavasya Tithi begins at 05:11 AM on May 16 and will end at 01:30 AM on May 17, 2026. On this sacred day, women wake up early in the morning, take a bath and dress in traditional attire. They often wear red or yellow saree and adorn themselves with bangles, bindis and sindoor. Married women observe a strict fast, pray for the long life of their husbands, and perform rituals under the banyan tree. We wish you all a Happy Vat Savitri Vrat 2026!
